helper_semantics: Each event interval starts only after the original host gate is released with both markers and the real Invocation submission already queued; no raw cudaGraphLaunch or permission bypass.

The interval is Queue device elapsed time, including gaps/preemption and any status work; it is not host CPU time or summed kernel busy time. Root NVTX walls include host gating/thread/retirement overhead and are not a benchmark.
Both profile and timing use the same numerical graph/full writer/leases; profile uses2warm+1measured while timing uses5warm+31measured. These samples are not pooled.
Every gate watchdog flag is false; public Graph Completions are waited before another episode. The final payloads are reread after all repeats.
Captured D2D64/4928B are real payload copies, not4B Queue status; no other measured memcpy is reported in these six roots.
